title: Ndụmọdụ ahụ e tinyere n'amamihe
intro: Chee echiche banyere otu onye a maara nke ọma, ọ bụghị maka ọrụ ebube ma ọ bụ alaeze, kama maka okwu ndị ka na-eduzi obi taa. Ohu Allah a natara onyinye dị oke ọnụ ahịa ma tinye ekele n'ime ndụmọdụ ọ bụla enyere onye mmụta ntorobịa a hụrụ n'anya.
clues: Chineke nyere m amamihe, e wee nye m iwu ka m kelee ya maka ya.
Agwara m nwa m nwoke okwu n'ụzọ dị nro, na-adọ ya aka ná ntị n'ịhụnanya na nchegbu.
Agwara m nwa m nwoke na iso Allah na-akpakọrịta bụ nnukwu ihe ọjọọ.
Agwara m nwa m nwoke ka o kpee ekpere, nye iwu ihe ọma, gbochie ihe ọjọọ, ma nwee ndidi.
Adọọla m nwa m nwoke aka ná ntị ka ọ ghara ịtụgharị ihu ya n'anya nganga ma ọ bụ ka ọ ghara ije ije n'elu ala n'anya nganga.
Akụziiri m nwa m nwoke ka ọ na-eme ihe n'ụzọ dị mma ma na-ebelata olu ya, n'ihi na ụda kacha njọ bụ mkpọtụ ịnyịnya ibu.

outcome.answer: Dịka ihe nlereanya nke ekele na ndụmọdụ amamihe dị na ndị nne na nna

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
